output.summary: Agency spend growth is about 77% volume and 23% rate. Volume tracks a rising vacancy rate driven by resignations. Resignations are driven mainly by charge and orientation load on permanent RNs, which agency use concentrates on them. Unit lag correlations peak at two quarters. The 4 West pilot cut load and exhaustion and lowered resignations against matched units, which supports a causal loop. Only 19 of 98 known leavers went to St. Brennan's, and all left after resignations had already been rising. Pay is cited by 17% of leavers. The 2025 bonus did not lower vacancy, and the proposed $15k bonus would suspend the charge and preceptor differentials, which worsens the loop. Extend the 4 West model. Rate renegotiation is a useful secondary step. The falls link is confounded by acuity and age.
